raw:
The user wants a push notification for a parking app in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan context - NT$, 信義停車場). The notification is about: user parked at 信義停車場, timer expires in 10 minutes, overtime costs NT$60 per hour.

Format: JSON only with s1 (title) and s2 (body).

Push notification best practices: title short, body concise, urgent tone, mention the key facts - 10 minutes left, NT$60/hour overtime charge.

Let me craft:

s1: "停車計時即將到期" or "計時剩 10 分鐘" - urgent
s2: "您在信義停車場的停車時間將於 10 分鐘後到期，超時將加收每小時 NT$60，請留意時間或續停。"

Keep it concise. Push notifications should be short.

s1: "計時剩餘 10 分鐘"
s2: "您的信義停車場停車計時即將到期，超時每小時加收 NT$60，請及時續停或移車。"

Only return JSON.</think>{"s1":"計時剩 10 分鐘","s2":"您在信義停車場的停車計時即將到期，超時每小時加收 NT$60，請留意時間或提前續停。"}

parsed.s2: 您在信義停車場的停車計時即將到期，超時每小時加收 NT$60，請留意時間或提前續停。
